crossRefs.note: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened…
O earth, earth, earth, hear Yahweh’s word!
Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have…
Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with…
Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

translations.web: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Be stunned by this, O heavens; be shocked and utterly appalled,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith Jehovah.
